content:
The [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) is a free online tool on CalcHub. When is my dog due? Whelping date from the mating date. Enter your mating date and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

When is your dog due? Enter the mating date and the calculator counts forward 63 days — the standard dog gestation — and gives the expected whelping date, the normal range (61–65 days), and the milestone dates: an ultrasound at day 28, an X-ray to count puppies at day 45, and preparing the whelping box at day 56. The dates are a guide for planning vet visits, not a substitute for veterinary care. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Dog Pregnancy Calculator

Start by picking your mating date. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. The steps below walk through each input in order.

1. Enter the mating date (or the ovulation date if you know it).
2. Read the expected due date and the normal range.
3. Use the milestone dates to plan vet visits.

## Formula

Due date = mating date + 63 days (normal range 61–65 days).

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. A mating on 1 November gives an expected due date of 3 January (range 1–5 January), with the ultrasound on 29 November. Try the same figures in the [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Mating date: 2026-11-21), the [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) returns Expected due date: Saturday, January 23, 2027, Normal range: Thursday, January 21, 2027 – Monday, January 25, 2027, Ultrasound check (day 28): Saturday, December 19, 2026, X-ray count (day 45): Tuesday, January 5, 2027, Prepare the whelping box (day 56): Saturday, January 16, 2027. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Random Picker](/random-picker) is worth a look before you finish.

## Why 63 days

Dog gestation is 63 days from ovulation, and mating usually happens within a day or two of ovulation, so 63 days from mating is the standard count. The normal range is 61–65 days; puppies born before day 58 rarely survive, and a pregnancy past day 66 needs a vet. If the mating date is uncertain, an ultrasound at day 28 gives a better estimate.

## Signs labour is near

A temperature drop below 37.2 °C (99 °F), restlessness, nesting, loss of appetite and panting usually mean labour within 24 hours. Have your vet's emergency number ready, and call if strong contractions last more than 30 minutes without a puppy, or if labour stalls for over two hours between puppies.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Count from the mating date — 63 days is the standard.
- Book the day-28 ultrasound to confirm the pregnancy and estimate the litter.
- Have your vet's emergency number ready before the due date.

## Frequently asked questions

### How long are dogs pregnant?

63 days from mating, on average — the normal range is 61 to 65 days. Try it with your own numbers in the [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### When can a vet confirm a dog pregnancy?

An ultrasound can confirm it from about day 28, and an X-ray can count the puppies from about day 45. Try it with your own numbers in the [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What if my dog goes past her due date?

A pregnancy past 66 days needs a vet — call yours rather than waiting. Puppies born before day 58 rarely survive. Try it with your own numbers in the [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What formula does the Dog Pregnancy Calculator use?

Due date = mating date + 63 days (normal range 61–65 days). You can see it in action in the [Dog Pregnancy Calculator](/dog-pregnancy-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.
